newsitem.title: UK: Yorks Water up in sector buoyed by bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Yorks Water up in sector buoyed by bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Water Plc hit a six-month high after dipping last week following the UK Budget and first-half results which included a dividend at the low end of analysts' forecasts.
At 1240 GMT, Yorkshire shares were up 17-1/2p at 707-1/2p.
Dealers said the sector was firm overall, with South West Water Plc up 9p at 596-1/2p and Severn Trent Plc up 5p at 665-1/2p.
"There have been some old bid rumours going around," one marketmaker said.
However, Wessex Water was down 2-1/2p at 351-1/2p after half-year profits met expectations but left investors disappointed over the lack of immediate plans to return benefits to shareholders.
